title: Biberovic's Game-Winner Seals Another Turkish Crown for Fenerbahce
description: Fenerbahce Beko are champions of Turkey once again, defending their title in the most dramatic fashion with a 77-75 win at Besiktas Gain in Game 4 to close out the Basketbol Super Ligi Finals 3-1. The decider in Istanbul came down to one unforgettable play: with the game in the balance, Wade Baldwin IV (193-PG-1996, college: Vanderbilt) conjured a pass from a near-impossible position to find Tarik Biberovic (201-SF-2001), who buried the three-pointer that won it. It was a fitting end to a tense, swinging contest in which Besiktas pushed the defending champions to the very last possession.
imageCaption: Biberovic's Game-Winner Seals Another Turkish Crown for Fenerbahce (Photo: Fenerbahce Beko)

title: Fenerbahce repeat as Basketball Super League champions
description: Fenerbahce - Besiktas 84-68 Fenerbahce defended their Basketball Super League title. They knocked down Besiktas in the fifth game of the championship series to capture the trophy. Nigel Hayes-Davis (203-F-1994, college: Wisconsin) came up with 16 points to pace the champions. Fenerbahce snatched a 21-18 lead after the opening quarter. They sank 27 points in the second stanza to gain a 48-40 halftime lead. Fenerbahce continued their dominance in the second half. They held Besiktas to just 14 points in the third frame to boost the lead to 15 points. Fenerbahce limited their cross-town rivals to just 14 points in the fourth final stanza and raced to the triumph. Wade Baldwin IV (193-G-1996, college: Vanderbilt) produced 13 points for Fenerbahce. Jonah Mathews (191-SG-1998, college: USC) replied with 19 points for Besiktas. Derek Needham (180-PG-1990, college: Fairfield) tossed in 14 points…
imageCaption: Fenerbahce repeat as Basketball Super League champions (Photo: Fenerbahce)

title: Fenerbahce outlast Anadolu Efes in overtime, clinch BSL title
description: Fenerbahce - Anadolu Efes 80-72 (OT) Fenerbahce are crowned 23/24 BSL champions. They outscored Anadolu Efes in overtime in Game 4 of the Finals to conquer the title. Nigel Hayes-Davis (203-F-1994, college: Wisconsin) finished with 16 points to pace the winners. Fenerbahce grabbed a comfortable 22-8 lead after ten minutes. But Anadolu Efes responded with a 25-14 run in the second stanza to pull within 3 points. The visitors held Fenerbahce to 15 points in the third quarter to eke out a single-point lead. But Fenerbahce limited their opponents to just 12 points in the final term as Nigel Hayes-Davis sent the game into overtime. The hosts poured in 16 points in the extra period and got away with the crucial win. Scottie Wilbekin (188-G-1993, college: Florida) produced 12 points for the champions. Tarik Biberovic (201-SF-2001) topscored with 19 points for Fenerbahce. Elijah Bryant…
imageCaption: Fenerbahce outlast Anadolu Efes in overtime, clinch BSL title (Photo: Fenerbahce)

title: Anadolu Efes conquer BSL title
description: Pinar Karsiyaka - Anadolu Efes 74-83 Anadolu Efes clinched BSL title. They overcame Pinar Karsiyaka in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But Pinar Karsiyaka won third quarter 17-16. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. The game was decided in the last minutes when Efes won last quarter 19-11. The best player for the winners was Serbian point guard Vasilije Micic (196-1994) who scored 29 points and 7 assists. The former international guard Shane Larkin (182-1992, college: Miami, FL) chipped in 15 points and 7 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was American guard Errick McCollum (188-1988, college: Goshen) who recorded a double-double by scoring 18 points and 11 assists and the other American import forward Vitto Brown (203-1995,…
imageCaption: Anadolu Efes conquer BSL title (Photo: gazetepencere.com)

title: Fenerbahce beat Anadolu Efes to clinch BSL title
description: Anadolu Efes - Fenerbahce 80-92 Fenerbahce clinched BSL title. They defeated Anadolu Efes on the road tonight to earn the decisive third win in the championship series. The victory marked the 10th Turkish League triumph for Fenerbahce. The game was mostly controlled by Fenerbahce. Efes managed to win second period 23-17. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They outrebounded Efes 31-20 including 23 on the defensive glass. Fenerbahce looked well-organized offensively handing out 28 assists. Worth to mention a great performance of Czech center Jan Vesely (213-1990, agency: BeoBasket) who helped to win the game recording 18 points and 7 rebounds (on 9-of-10 shooting from the field). Serbian swingman Marko Guduric (196-1995, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 16 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists for the winners. Serbian point guard Vasilije Micic (196-1994,…
imageCaption: Fenerbahce beat Anadolu Efes to clinch BSL title (Photo: BSL)

title: Anadolu Efes are ING BSL champions
description: Fenerbahce - Anadolu Efes 66-93 Anadolu Efes are 20/21 ING BSL champions. They breezed past Fenerbahce in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep and lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 4 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 12-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 93-66. Anadolu Efes dominated on the defensive end, holding Fenerbahce to just 7 points in second quarter. They outrebounded Fenerbahce 33-20 including 24 on the defensive glass. Anadolu Efes looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. The best player for the winners was French guard Rodrigue Beaubois (190-88, agency: BeoBasket) who scored 30 points and 4 assists (on 11-of-13 shooting from the field). International guard Ahmet Tuncer (193-93) chipped in 13 points, 5 rebounds and 7 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was French…
